quests.name: Slime Supplies
quests.description: Collect slime gel from the slimes roaming the meadow.

dialogue.offer: The meadow slimes are fouling my mixtures. Bring me five portions of Slime Gel and I will pay you.
dialogue.in_progress: I still need five portions of Slime Gel. The meadow slimes should have what we need.
dialogue.ready: That is enough Slime Gel. Hand it over and I will reward your work.
dialogue.completed: Your Slime Gel was exactly what I needed. Thank you again.

quests.name: Wing Samples
quests.description: Retrieve intact wings from cave bats in the cavern.

dialogue.offer: I am studying the cave bats, but I need three intact Bat Wings. Venture into the cavern and retrieve them for me.
dialogue.in_progress: The cavern bats are elusive. Keep searching until you have three intact Bat Wings.
dialogue.ready: Those wings are excellent specimens. Let me take them off your hands.
dialogue.completed: The wing samples have already taught me a great deal. You have my thanks.
